capabilities: Browse, filter, and paginate issues in a ready-first pane with Ready/In progress/Blocked/Closed tabs
Edit beads in a tab with typed properties and markdown fields saved back via bd update
Embed live, clickable issue queries in notes with beads code blocks
Visualize a bead's dependency lineage as a navigable graph
Manage multiple bd workspaces and follow changes live via bd's events journal
extras: Desktop only (shells out to bd via child_process). Detailed security model section: no network requests, untrusted bead text escaped, shell-injection-safe argument arrays, and provenance-attested releases. Live updates require bd 1.3.0+ with the events journal, which the user must enable.
intentEvidence: No Obsidian + Beads plugin existed before this one
motivation: The author notes no Obsidian + Beads plugin existed before and built one for people who track work in bd and live in Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian has no way to view, filter, or edit issues tracked in the bd CLI without leaving the vault for a terminal.

relations.evidence: Beads — bd --help, bd list --json, bd show --json, bd close.
High-star pane/view plugins (Kanban, Tasks, Dataview) for ItemView and workspace-leaf conventions.

requires.name: bd CLI on PATH (or an explicit binary path)

summary: Live pane and editor for the Beads (bd) issue tracker, with inline editing, query embeds, dependency graphs, and live updates.
